items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Art Blakey said, “ 51 pieces are you kidding!? You can’t hit that little joint..."

ctx.x: Billy Cobham. Art Blakey said, “ 51 pieces are you kidding!? You can’t hit that little joint, you have to get up off the stool and walk around in front of it to hit it!” He said, “why don’t you learn how to play the three drums that are there?” Hana was wanting to talk, he was always going up to the microphone saying, “in this particular arrangement I play the polyphonic…” Boy it was funny!

One Time I saw Brooks and he had these toy drummers, he had all these toys drummers. In some kind of way he could… He had this laser thing that he could trigger them with. You know when the Chinese had like the – – he had like an army of toy drummers in some kind of a way he was triggering the shit. He was out there.
